correctness.rationale: For integral displacements the sum of the absolute displacements at the two neighboring positions equals twice the central absolute displacement except for a correction of two at a fixed point. Directly subtracting at the two endpoints gives −f(1) and f(n)−(n+1), including n=2. In S_n the double-centered squared norm of |i−j| divided by n−1 gives Var D=(n+1)(2n²+7)/45. Conditioning on each fixed-point event deletes one row and column, yielding Cov(D,F)=−(n+1)/3. Sampling the two endpoint images without replacement gives Var Δ=n(n+1)/6 and Cov(D,Δ)=−n(n+1)/6; conditioning on an endpoint fixed gives Cov(F,Δ)=1. Together with Var F=1 this gives (2)–(3), including strict negativity at n=2,3 and positivity for n≥4. For R=2F+Δ, Var R=n(n+1)/6+8 and Cov(D,R)=O(n²). Its variance after regression on D is n²/6+O(n), yielding the leading correlation loss Var(R residual)/(8 Var D) = 15/(32n)+O(n^−2). The centered R has standard deviation O(n), negligible compared with the n^(3/2) footrule scale, so the standard combinatorial CLT for the double-centered footrule array (entry size O(n) versus standard deviation of order n^(3/2)) transfers to W. As an independent algebraic route for full maps, independence gives Var D=(n²−1)(3n²+8)/(60n), Var F=1−1/n, Cov(D,F)=−(n²−1)/(3n), Var Δ=−Cov(D,Δ)=(n²−1)/6 and Cov(F,Δ)=(n−1)/n. Substituting in the identity gives (5). Each centered independent W row contribution is O(n), negligible at the n^(3/2) total scale, so Lindeberg applies. The leading variance coefficients are 8/45 and 1/5, giving 8/9. Uniform image marginals give the same mean in both laws, without assuming permutation images independent.

value.rationale: The same natural transformation statistic has identical means but different exact fluctuations under sampling with and without replacement. The decomposition identifies which local coincidences and endpoints affect those fluctuations; the small-order covariance reversal versus strong positive asymptotic correlation and the nonunit variance ratio quantify meaningful differences that a mean or a general CLT would conceal.
residual_risks: The scope is uniform full maps and permutations only; not a statement about all partial transformation statistics.
